## Install (about 1 minute)

1. Download **quietshield.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Drag the unzipped **quietshield** folder onto the page.

Step-by-step guide with pictures: https://arjun-vegeta.github.io/QuietShield/

Keep the folder where it is — Chrome loads the extension from it. To update, replace the folder's contents with the new version and click the reload icon on the QuietShield card.

Built with the latest Brave default filter lists at release time. Version {{VERSION}}.
